description: Storage policy for MavlinOS agents inside Arch Linux under WSL2. Free space inside the WSL virtual disk is not the ceiling; the Windows volume that stores the virtual disk is. Thresholds are applied to whichever filesystem holds the data, and Windows volumes take priority when both are present.

response.NORMAL: Continue normally and refresh the inventory.
response.WARNING: Notify the owner, name the largest consumers, and estimate the cost of the planned operation before starting it.
response.CRITICAL: Do not start a large operation without first evaluating capacity and possible archival or cleanup.
response.EMERGENCY: Stop nonessential storage-intensive work, preserve current research state, and report the exact filesystem and paths responsible. Never delete research data to make room.

retention.active: Research inputs and outputs of the current objective stay local.
retention.archive: Verified completed research is committed to the private repository AnsvipaRinh/MavlinOS before local removal.
retention.reproducible: Intermediate data may be removed once inputs, scripts and reproduction commands are preserved.
retention.never: Irreplaceable raw evidence, QEMU disks, VM backups, installation media and saved states are never deleted automatically.
